subject.title: Feature: Configurable Permissions-Policy and CSP headers for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable Control UI CSP and Permissions-Policy headers, and which directives/value forms are safe to support?
rationale: The request adds new config surface for browser security boundaries, so automation should not decide whether to allow raw overrides, directive-limited extensions, or no configurability.

options.title: Approve Narrow Typed Policy
options.body: Add directive-limited config under the Control UI gateway config with strict validation, docs, and header tests while preserving hardened defaults.

options.title: Prefer Same-Origin Extension Routes
options.body: Decline general browser-header overrides and route local integrations through plugin or gateway routes that avoid broadening CSP.

options.title: Keep Fixed Allowlists
options.body: Continue adding only narrowly justified built-in allowlist entries for core-owned Control UI features.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Typed Policy
recommendation.body: Add directive-limited config under the Control UI gateway config with strict validation, docs, and header tests while preserving hardened defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history across Control UI framing, CSP helper ownership, and recent CSP policy changes.
